Navratri Devotees Visit Temples for Second Day Worship

On the second day of Navratri, devotees visited temples to worship Goddess Brahmacharini and Goddess Sharda. Priests performed pujas and aartis, with some reports mentioning the significance of chanting mantras and reciting prayers. Devotees were seen arriving to offer prayers and seek blessings.
